headline: GTA VI's new trailer offers a 90-second look at Vice City's Miami-inflected vibe
summary: Rockstar Games has released a brief "launch" trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI, captured entirely on PS5, featuring a new track from Justice and a glimpse of the game's story.
details: Rockstar Games has dropped a new 90-second "launch" trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI, offering a final look before its release. The clip, captured entirely on PS5, highlights the game's Miami-inflected vibe and features a new track from electronic duo Justice. Music is a significant focus in GTA VI, as with past titles.

The trailer also provides a brief overview of the game's narrative: protagonists Jason and Lucia find themselves entangled in a criminal conspiracy across the state of Leonida after an easy score goes wrong. They must rely on each other to survive the darkest side of America's sunniest place.

For those seeking more in-depth gameplay, Rockstar previously released a lengthy "extended look" in August, showcasing the cinematic experience. Meanwhile, various leaks related to the game have continued to circulate online, revealing additional elements.
Grand Theft Auto VI is set to launch on November 19th for PS5 and Xbox. This release comes 13 years after the last main GTA title, marking a highly anticipated return for the franchise.

headline_marked: [[Touchscreen MacBook Pro]] and more reportedly launching at Apple event on Oct 28
headline: Touchscreen MacBook Pro and more reportedly launching at Apple event on Oct 28
summary: A new report suggests Apple will unveil its first MacBook Pro with a touchscreen and OLED display. The highly anticipated launch is rumored for an October 28 event.
details: Apple is reportedly preparing to introduce its first MacBook Pro models featuring a touchscreen and an OLED display. This significant shift would mark a major evolution in the MacBook lineup, bringing touch capabilities long present on iPads to the Mac.

According to a new report from 9to5Mac, these anticipated devices are slated for an unveiling at an Apple event on October 28. While Apple has not officially confirmed the event or the products, the report cites sources familiar with the company's plans.

The move to OLED would offer superior contrast, deeper blacks, and improved power efficiency compared to current LCD panels. A touchscreen would also open new interaction paradigms for macOS, potentially bridging the gap between Apple's tablet and laptop experiences.
caption:
Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro with an OLED display is reportedly on its way! A new report points to an October 28 launch event.

Apple is reportedly preparing to introduce its first MacBook Pro models featuring a touchscreen and an OLED display. This significant shift would mark a major evolution in the MacBook lineup, bringing touch capabilities long present on iPads to the Mac.

According to a new report from 9to5Mac, these anticipated devices are slated for an unveiling at an Apple event on October 28. While Apple has not officially confirmed the event or the products, the report cites sources familiar with the company's plans.

The move to OLED would offer superior contrast, deeper blacks, and improved power efficiency compared to current LCD panels. A touchscreen would also open new interaction paradigms for macOS, potentially bridging the gap between Apple's tablet and laptop experiences.
